content: {"episode_id":"ep-05030","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Review is requested for the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), for which required prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note describes recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack. Given the history of sick sinus syndrome, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmic or tachyarrhythmic activity."}
